'''2008 Texas State Championship''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG state championship played on Saturday 23 August 2008 at Skirmish Games, 8317 Spencer Hwy, Deer Park, Texas, with [[Mike Richards|Michael Richards]] as tournament director.<ref name="sf-22067-318032">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=318032#p318032 Texas States], mr007agent (Michael Richards), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (25 July 2008).</ref> [[James Barnes]] received its bye into Day 2 of the [[2008 World Championship|World Championship]].<ref name="sf-22883-332133">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=332133#p332133 List of People who have Worlds Day Two Auto Bids 2008], simone89 (Cedric Simon), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 August 2008).</ref>

== Organization ==

Richards announced the event on 25 July 2008 as a constructed Swiss tournament of three rounds (six games), starting at 11:00 am, with an unlimited card pool and a $5 entry fee. Prizes were $155 in cash for three random players, a bye into Day 2 of the World Championship, and the Players Committee's Ultimate prize package: a tournament trophy, a virtual card design for the winner, 30 random rares, 30 booster packs, three random EPP/EJP/ECC tuck packs, six tournament foils, posters and pins, and three sets of virtual card cut sheets.<ref name="sf-22067-318032" /> Asked on 18 August whether Virtual Set 16 would be legal, [[Blake Huffman]] answered "Yep".<ref name="sf-22067-327469">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=327469#p327469 Texas States], GadoTheLion, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (18 August 2008).</ref><ref name="sf-22067-327486">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=327486#p327486 Texas States], Anodos (Blake Huffman), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (18 August 2008).</ref>
